summary: Leading eigenpairs of the steady cubic cavity flow at Re = 1920. One pair is unstable: sigma = +5.84e-4, omega = 0.5868.
description: Direct stability (mode 3.1) about the steady flow of 210_baseflow_newton/fp at Re = 1920, uniform lid. The leading pair has a positive growth rate, so the steady flow is unstable: Re = 1920 lies above the first Hopf bifurcation. The expected values are those of the run named under produced, not literature values. The frequency of the leading pair agrees with St = 0.0934 of the thesis (Table 4.1): 2 pi St = 0.5869. The leading pair of the same flow at Re = 1914 has sigma = -1.8296e-4 and omega = 0.58684 (cubic_cavity_re1914/310_stability_direct), so the tolerance of 2e-5 on sigma fails that stage and any run at a wrong Reynolds number (d sigma / d Re = 1.3e-4 per unit of Re). The second pair is stable, sigma = -0.0211, omega = 0.561; it checks that the unstable pair is the only one.

leading_sigma.note: Growth rate of the leading pair (positive: unstable).

second_sigma.note: Growth rate of the second pair (third row of the file): stable.
